name: LocalAI
description: Serves local LLM, vision, image and voice inference behind an OpenAI-compatible API, letting agents run on consumer hardware with no GPU required.

skills.name: OpenAI-Compatible API
skills.description: Exposes chat, embedding and audio endpoints matching the OpenAI schema so existing SDKs work unchanged.

skills.name: Model Gallery
skills.description: Downloads and manages models from a built-in gallery across multiple backends and quantization formats.

skills.name: Multimodal Inference
